# Upstream file classification for check-upstream.sh / upstream-check.yml
#
# Format: <upstream-path>|<STATUS>|<note>
#   MAPPED — note is where the equivalent logic lives in this repo. The file
#            is diffed (merge-base -> upstream/main); changes are reported
#            with a pointer to our local path so review is fast.
#   IGNORE — note is why. The file is never diffed or reported. Only use
#            this for things genuinely inapplicable to a web server (Wails
#            desktop UI plumbing) — never to silence something we just
#            haven't looked at yet.
#
# Anything upstream lists under backend/*.go, app.go or main.go that is NOT
# in this file is auto-classified UNMAPPED: reported as "needs manual
# triage", never silently dropped. This is what catches genuinely new
# upstream files (new provider, new feature) without us having to remember
# to update this list proactively — the discovery is automatic, only the
# classification of *known* files is manual.
#
# Two files are deliberately left UNMAPPED (not IGNORE) even though we've
# already read them, because classification depends on an open decision
# rather than a known mapping:
#   - mp4ff_decrypt.go — DRM content decryption (CENC). Needs an explicit
#     conformité/ToS decision with the user before it's even worth deciding
#     where (or whether) it maps to anything here.
#   - resample.go — FLAC resampling feature. Unclear whether it's already
#     covered by our existing audio converter or genuinely new; needs a
#     closer look before claiming a mapping.
#
# frontend/ is intentionally out of scope entirely: upstream is a Wails
# desktop UI, ours is a from-scratch React web app (R1/R9 rewrote most of
# it) — there is no meaningful file-level mapping to maintain there.

amazon.go|MAPPED|backend/amazon/
analysis.go|MAPPED|backend/audio/analysis.go
artist_format.go|MAPPED|backend/util/filename.go (multi-artist splitting — pairs with our useFirstArtistOnly setting)
community_apikey.go|IGNORE|Contains an AES-GCM encrypted community API key with the decryption key derivable from a literal in the same file — deliberately never decrypted or reused, see community_endpoints.go
community_endpoints.go|MAPPED|no single local file yet — doCommunityRequest's 429/503/Retry-After retry+cooldown pattern is a port candidate for backend/tidal, backend/qobuz, backend/amazon (none of which handle rate-limit responses today); the AES-GCM encrypted proxy URLs/key in this file are deliberately never decrypted or reused
config.go|MAPPED|backend/util/config.go
cover.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/cover.go
download_cancel.go|IGNORE|Global "stop all downloads" cancellation scope — a single-user Wails desktop concept; doesn't map to our multi-user server (would cancel every user's jobs at once). We cancel per-job in jobs_worker.go instead
download_validation.go|MAPPED|no local equivalent yet — port target: post-download duration check to catch a Tidal community PREVIEW (30s) landing as if it were the full track, which we currently don't detect at all
ffmpeg.go|MAPPED|backend/audio/ffmpeg.go
ffmpeg_unix.go|IGNORE|Desktop build's local-ffmpeg path discovery; we always run in Docker with ffmpeg bundled at a fixed path (backend/util/ffmpegpath.go)
ffmpeg_windows.go|IGNORE|Same as ffmpeg_unix.go — desktop-only path discovery, not applicable to our Docker-only deployment
file_dialog.go|IGNORE|Wails native file picker — our intentional web equivalent is backend/file_dialog_web.go (stub by design)
fileicon_darwin.go|IGNORE|Desktop-only file icon rendering, no web equivalent needed
fileicon_stub.go|IGNORE|Desktop-only stub companion to fileicon_darwin.go
filemanager.go|MAPPED|backend/filemanager.go
filename.go|MAPPED|backend/util/filename.go
folder.go|IGNORE|Wails native folder picker — our intentional web equivalent is backend/folder_web.go (stub by design)
history.go|MAPPED|backend/history.go
http_headers.go|MAPPED|backend/providerutil/useragent.go — already equivalent (same Chrome UA + default headers pattern)
isrc_cache.go|MAPPED|backend/spotify/ — a second, anonymous-token path to resolve a track's ISRC, NOT library/file matching despite the filename
isrc_finder.go|MAPPED|backend/spotify/ — anonymous Spotify token client backing isrc_cache.go and isrc_helper.go
isrc_helper.go|MAPPED|backend/spotify/ — thin facade over isrc_finder.go + isrc_cache.go
link_resolver.go|MAPPED|backend/songlink/ — orchestrates which cross-provider link resolver to try and in what order
lyrics.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/lyrics.go
lyrics_reader.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/ — reads lyrics already embedded in a file (the reverse direction of lyrics.go, which fetches/embeds); check whether we already read lyrics back out anywhere
main.go|IGNORE|Wails desktop bootstrap (window/tray/lifecycle) — our main.go is a from-scratch HTTP server entrypoint, nothing to compare
metadata.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/metadata.go
musicbrainz.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/musicbrainz.go — check against the deferred R10 finding (retag-incomplete-metadata over-selecting on genre) before anything else, this is likely where the fix lives
progress.go|MAPPED|backend/util/progress.go
provider_endpoints.go|MAPPED|already equivalent — our Amazon default endpoint (amazon.spotbye.qzz.io) already matches theirs
qobuz.go|MAPPED|backend/qobuz/
qobuz_api.go|MAPPED|backend/qobuz/ — scraped/cached Qobuz "open app" credentials for signed requests, a possible direct fix for the parked Qobuz 401 issue
qobuz_community.go|MAPPED|backend/qobuz/ — community proxy fallback, same pattern as tidal_community.go
recent_fetches.go|MAPPED|backend/history.go (recent search/fetch history) — low priority
songlink.go|MAPPED|backend/songlink/
songstats.go|MAPPED|backend/songlink/ — Songstats API, one of the link resolvers link_resolver.go orchestrates
spotfetch.go|MAPPED|backend/spotify/ (Filter* functions — compare against R2's typed output rewrite before porting anything)
spotify_metadata.go|MAPPED|backend/spotify/metadata.go
spotify_totp.go|MAPPED|backend/spotify/ (TOTP auth helpers)
tagging.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/ — rewritten around go.senan.xyz/taglib, a new upstream dependency; looks like an in-progress migration away from metadata.go's hand-rolled per-format tag code, compare both before porting either
tidal.go|MAPPED|backend/tidal/
tidal_community.go|MAPPED|backend/tidal/ — community proxy fallback
upc_tags.go|MAPPED|backend/meta/ — album UPC tag extraction/classification, pairs with metadata.go/tagging.go
app.go|IGNORE|Upstream's monolithic orchestrator; we deliberately decomposed the equivalent (App god-object) into Container services (R3, docs/audit-refactoring-couche2.md). A line-diff here is mostly noise — a genuinely new capability landing in app.go upstream will almost always also touch one of the tracked/unmapped provider files above, which is where it'll actually get flagged.
